description: Stablecoin market data with the number agents paying in USDC actually need: current price and PEG DEVIATION per coin, circulating supply, peg mechanism and chains, ranked by market cap. Filter by symbol or screen for depegs (absolute deviation above a threshold). Open DefiLlama data, refreshed every 10 minutes. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC, Base).

_payment.description: Optional base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE payload. Omit to receive payment requirements.

max_peg_deviation_percent.description: Depeg screen: only coins with ABSOLUTE deviation >= this value (e.g. 0.5)

symbol.description: Filter by symbol substring, e.g. USDC
